tools.name: find_items
tools.description: Search CS2 items by name and get their exact market_hash_names, which every other tool takes. Every word must appear in the name; punctuation is ignored.

tools.name: get_offers
tools.description: The cheapest listing (lowest sell offer) of each item on every marketplace that lists it, in US dollars. Use it to price items or find where they are cheapest.

tools.name: get_buy_orders
tools.description: The highest buy order of each item on each marketplace that has buy orders, in US dollars: what the item sells for right now without waiting for a buyer.

tools.name: get_sales_summary
tools.description: Each item's sales: how many sold, and the median and average price, over the last 7, 15, 30 and 90 days, plus its typical 15-day volume.

tools.name: get_items
tools.description: What each item is: type, weapon, pattern, wear and float range, quality (StatTrak™, Souvenir...), rarity, collections, cases, picture.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description: Every CS2 item in a Steam inventory: market_hash_name, asset ID, class ID, instance ID and inspect link. Give a steam_id (SteamID64) for a public inventory, or a trade_url for any inventory, private ones too. Price the items with get_offers.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_sales_summary" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Each item's sales: how many sold, and the median and average price, over the last 7, 15, 30 and 90 days, plus its typical 15-day volume. Needs a paid plan." → after: "Each item's sales: how many sold, and the median and average price, over the last 7, 15, 30 and 90 days, plus its typical 15-day volume."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
